headline: Exchange Flow Falls To An 84.8 Million Dollar Outflow From A 1,295.5 Million Inflow
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues fell to an 84.8 million dollar net outflow, 0.0314 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, from a 1,295.5 million dollar inflow at 0.4782 percent. Bitstamp shed 170.8 million dollars, Binance shed 89.6 million dollars, and Bitget shed 62.3 million dollars, while Bitfinex took in 132.2 million dollars. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, so a negative print means dollars left those venues and a positive print means dollars arrived where holders can sell.
author: jordan
